subject: P0 FIELD REGRESSION: INNER display still wakes only around 50-60deg + first opening animation crashes then recovers

field_observation.correction: Target is INNER display, not rear/cover display.
field_observation.wake_failure: INNER panel remains dark until device is opened approximately 50-60 degrees; existing Beta2 physical NORMAL + logical-route wake protocol is therefore not sufficient to illuminate/present on the inner panel at the intended early-opening point.
field_observation.first_open_crash: On the first animation/opening attempt the app/animation path crashes, then attempts recovery.
field_observation.post_full_open_behavior: After the inner display has opened fully and the system is running, subsequent fold animations are comparatively smooth.
field_observation.human_priority: Start investigation immediately; this is the main device R&D blocker.

required_research: Determine the actual Samsung/Fold7 inner-panel wake/enable sequence below or beside current SurfaceControl physical power + logical display route calls; distinguish panel power, DisplayManager logical state, device-state policy, composition readiness and first useful pixels.

Identify why the first opening attempt crashes while later attempts are smooth; focus on first-use initialization, display/topology swap, Surface/SurfaceControl ownership, stale generations, null/removed display races and route handoff ordering.
Correlate this field result with prior Gen6 findings that physical wake success is not useful-presentation proof and that topology/OPEN_INNER/wallpaper cannot be treated as readiness.

Design instrumentation that timestamps opening edge, Samsung device state, hinge source, physical display token power request/result, logical route enable/state, DisplayManager add/change/remove, Surface creation/attachment, first frame, first useful native presentation, process/service death and recovery.
Preserve current smooth post-open animation behavior and all close-path/rotation/live-content fixes while investigating.
acceptance_target: INNER panel visibly illuminates and can present the continuity bridge near the earliest trusted opening edge, not only at 50-60 degrees.
First opening attempt does not crash or tear down/recreate the visual path.
Subsequent opening/closing remains smooth with no regression.
Readiness is proven by useful presentation evidence, not merely physical/logical power receipts.
